title: Pão de Leite
description: A traditional Brazilian all-purpose flour wrap with a malty, springy texture, perfect for snacks or light meals. The nuka-pickle adds a tangy, slightly sweet flavor.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine warm water, sugar, and yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Add the all-purpose flour, nuka-pickle, and salt to the bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place the disks on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each wrap.
Bake the wraps in the preheated oven for 15 minutes until they are golden brown.
Remove the wraps from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
To serve, place a wrap on a lotus leaf or a plate, and fill with your favorite fillings such as cheese, ham, or turkey.
